name: Timely Ward
oracle_text:
You may cast this spell as though it had flash if it targets a commander.
Enchant creature
Enchanted creature has indestructible.
blocked_sentences: You may cast this spell as though it had flash if it targets a commander.

needs.what: a card-level conditional flash permission whose condition reads the targets chosen for the spell itself: the card may be cast at instant speed only when its chosen target (here the Aura's enchant target) matches a selector such as `is_commander: true`. The cast must allow the card to be begun outside sorcery timing, then verify at target selection (601.2c) that the target matches, and reject/rewind the cast if it does not -- the same shape Ranger's Guile-style 'if it targets' riders and Nature's Way/Savage Smash-adjacent 'cast as though it had flash if' printings need
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `flash` is unconditional; the `cast_as_though_flash` static is a player-wide permission whose `affects_spells` filter reads only the printed characteristics of the face being cast and whose `condition` reads the board (static_condition_keys), never the spell's chosen targets; `grant_flash_permission` is a one-shot op from another source. `casting._timing_ok` decides timing from the CardDef and player statics before targets exist, so nothing can make timing depend on what the spell targets. Writing plain `flash` would be strictly better than the printed card (instant-speed Aura on any creature)
